metadata.purpose: Accumulate source values in time-bounded windows, possibly overlapping, and emit each window on its timer or size threshold.

conditions: Each window yields one array; empty windows also emit on timer expiry.
A creation interval opens overlapping windows; omitted interval restarts one window on every close.
A maximum size can close a window early, before its timer; completion flushes all open windows and errors/cancellation discard.
When a value fills a window, a replacement window opened by this value does not receive that same value.

scope.parameters: Positive safe-integer span, optional positive safe-integer creation interval, optional positive safe-integer max size; bounded virtual clock/timer generations
scope.callbacks: No user callback. Emitted arrays contain retained source references in arrival order.
scope.time: External monotone safe-integer clock. Timer fires are explicit events, never inferred from a deadline; due firings are allowed late but not early. Equal-time order is explicit.
scope.reentrancy: Deferred, non-reentrant scheduler and nonthrowing observers. Source notifications and timer firings are atomic, ordered by event sequence.
exclusions: Negative/NaN/fractional/unsafe spans, zero span or zero creation interval, custom inline schedulers, arbitrary scheduler jitter guarantees.
Reentrant observer/source events during a timer callback or buffer emission, throwing finalizers and cancellation inside delivery.
Exact JS SchedulerAction identities, operator internals of Date.now and universal state-space equivalence.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Start one empty window and its closing timer before acquiring the source; if creation interval is supplied schedule repeated window openings.

ownership.sharing: No sharing. Each result subscription owns independent scheduled windows and accumulation arrays.
ownership.reset: Fresh window identities and timer schedules on each subscription; terminal state drops all buffers.

dispatch.actionSemantics: A source next is copied into the windows open before that next. Full windows are removed then emitted; a no-interval replacement opens only after the value is processed. Expired window fires remove, emit, and optionally reopen.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external source, window and creation events; no silent final flush.
All logical timers are cancelled on error or cancellation; the exact host Action object is intentionally abstracted.

rules.explanation: A source next updates every already-open window. At a size threshold, windows close early and can cause a new non-overlap window to begin.

rules.guard: matching live window and due deadline
rules.nextState: active with remaining windows and optional new window
rules.explanation: A timer firing at or after the deadline closes its own window. A late timer does not backdate output.

rules.explanation: Source completion flushes every currently open window (including an empty one) and does not open another.

rules.explanation: An error does not emit any currently accumulated window.
